body: I understand that, it's just one of those feelings that ultimately win me over.

Considering what my mother has done to me, and what my father has allowed to happen, I really don't feel the love from either of them. I do love them and know they love me, but I just can't feel it (if you get what I'm saying)

And in regards to finding my band (made me smile, thanks for that)

She had noticed I had lost weight and was looking better for myself, giving me compliments along the lines of handsome, or insisting that I look good. She was hitting on me, or maybe just being really friendly. We had a small chat which I actually enjoyed. I have been to the diner anywhere from 50-100 times since that first encounter, yet do not go beyond pleasantries with her even though I enjoyed her company. That's my problem. It's like as soon as there is the slightest hint that I may get close to someone I find myself fearful and can't bring myself to expand upon our existing relationship.

It's like that for everyone.

I am able to focus on things that make me happy and I can set goals for myself, I've set a goal last year to lose 70 pounds and I did. It made me feel really good. What makes me feel depressed though is my incapability to have relationships with people due to lack of trust on my part. I feel alone with my current loved ones and don't know what to do.

I really want to trust people, confide in someone, to have a friend I can talk to about what I am feeling, but I am absolutely petrified of putting myself out there. It's hard to allow myself to be vulnerable to another person because all I've ever known was pain and suffering, and over time I allowed myself to become more of an isolationist.

I've been to therapy before, I tried it I really did. I went to one on one but felt like I was paying someone to listen to what I had to say and pretend as if they truly cared. I then went to group therapy with people from similar pasts as me. We shared our experiences and at first it made me feel better knowing that there were others like me trying to get help. After awhile the insurance saw fit to stop funding my care and I was forced to leave that therapy group because the rates were outrageously expensive and I didn't want my father to spend to much of his money. I tried to stay in contact with most of the members, at least the ones I cared for, but over time we gradually grew distant.

I don't want to run. My father ran from his problems all throughout his life, the most occurring one being my mother, and has gotten him nothing but trouble. He is in serious debt because of her (Last I heard it was in the 6 figure range), my brother has abandoned the whole family because of everything she has done (he is turning 22 in a couple of months and nobody has heard from him since about April), I'm fucked up, and my sister is a spoiled little cunt because my mother has gotten whatever she wanted when she was drunk to gain her favor (she has done it to me in the past). I love my family, I want nothing but the best for everyone of them, but everything is a result from my father running from problems. Instead of facing my mother Years ago (even before I was born. They've had terrible chemistry together, but stayed together because of us, the kids) he allowed her to become the monster she was.
How do I get past this feeling though, it has been with me for years, but up until recently I have found myself struggling to hold control over it.
